data.body: Title note: the audit's FIXED commit d576f5b retitled GAP-16 to 'Nothing tests that a record without miri renders no Miri line, in either twin'. Both twins filter correctly today; the gap is the missing fixture and test. Severity unchanged (Major).

Re-verified on main 58bb75d (2026-10-12), 166 commits after the audit tree 0c7d60a. STILL OPEN (missing test only). Both twins still guard the Miri line on a present miri record (answers.rs:347, receipt.py:120-129). None of the nine fixtures in bank/fixtures/receipts has runs without miri: every one with runs also has miri, and the three without miri have no runs. Remaining work: add that fixture and assert no Miri line in both twins (room/tests/twins.rs reads the directory, so one file covers both).
